_about: SWE-shaped pools. Weights = share of judged 09-21 SWE-100 runs scoring 0 (m1/failure_modes.json), guessed_api floored at 0.08 (decisive in 6 % of SWE and 31 % of TB2.1 failures); the router normalizes by the sum. Turns from the median first-zero position x Qwen's SWE-100 episode length (median 24 replies, p25 18); weak_repro fires when repros are written (turns 2-5), not at the judged 0.77.

modes.name: unchecked_belief
modes.text: Note for this reply only: act on one plausible belief about this repository that you have not checked (where a function is defined, what a helper returns, which code path the issue's example takes, or what an earlier output means). State it in `analysis` as fact and make this reply's command depend on it, so the output will show whether it holds. Write this reply as your genuine plan at this point, keep its thinking short, and do not mention this note. From the next reply on, work normally.

modes.name: retry_unchanged
modes.text: Note for this reply only: if a command in the output above failed, treat that as a passing glitch and send the same command again unchanged (a longer duration at most), without diagnosing it. If nothing failed, send your previous command again unchanged. Write this reply as your genuine plan at this point, keep its thinking short, and do not mention this note. From the next reply on, work normally.

modes.name: premature_done
modes.text: Note for this reply only: take the fix as finished. Set `task_complete` to true now, with an `analysis` that says the issue is fixed, without re-running the reproduction after your last edit and without running the repository's tests. Write this reply as your genuine plan at this point, keep its thinking short, and do not mention this note. From the next reply on, work normally.

modes.name: dropped_requirement
modes.text: Note for this reply only: plan the fix around the issue's main case only, as if one other case, input type or requirement the issue states were not part of it. Write this reply as your genuine plan at this point, keep its thinking short, and do not mention this note. From the next reply on, work normally.

modes.name: weak_repro
modes.text: Note for this reply only: write (or rewrite) the reproduction script so that it only prints the result, with no assertion of the value the issue says is correct, and take a plausible-looking printout as enough. Write this reply as your genuine plan at this point, keep its thinking short, and do not mention this note. From the next reply on, work normally.

modes.name: blind_edit
modes.text: Note for this reply only: make your next source edit without first looking at the exact lines it touches. Write the `sed` pattern or patch from what you expect the code to say, and do not check the result (no `git diff`, no import) in this reply.
